answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one vault weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The meadow report makes public the merge explicitly at each mesa. Because of that, an attacker who spins up 197 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 146 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3532 identities would post 603 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
